behavior.laps.note:
NotImplementedError: Positions cannot be assigned to the bins of a track built without track_width.
Why: a centerline and bin size do not say how far from the centerline a position is still on the track, so a position far off the track (a reflection or a tracking jump) would be put in its nearest bin.
Fix: give the track its measured full width, in the units of the positions, with env.with_track_width(width); it keeps the bins and works on a saved, subset or transformed track too. A new track takes track_width= in Environment.linear_track, Environment.maze or Environment.from_graph
